title: State of U.P. v. Chhotey Lal

content.caseIdentity: State of U.P. v. Chhotey Lal, (2011) 2 SCC 550
content.holding: Affirmed that the statutory fiction in gang rape provisions imputes the completed act of rape to every member of the group acting in concert, and absence of independent physical injuries does not diminish the gravity of joint culpability.
